page.overview:
Who is Woan Barso?

Woan Barso was a human male Because of this, the Guardians of the Whills Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe did not trust him to be able to help them evacuate an orphanage.

In 1 BBY, the Alliance to Restore the Republic agents Jyn Erso and Cassian Andor passed Barso as he stood in the city shortly before the entire settlement was destroyed by the Empire's Death Star superweapon.

Years later, Barso became to a powerful pirate leader who would attend the summit held by Zeva Bliss.

Woan Barso first appeared in the film Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, which was released in North America on December 15, 2016. The character was not named in the film itself, but received identification in the reference book Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide.
